caveats: Warm-cache wall-time microbenchmark on one desktop; no validator TPS or capacity claim.
BOC stages deserialize a native batch BOC, not the complete candidate Block wrapper.
Stage costs overlap and must not be summed as exclusive CPU attribution.
Repeated-output workload models same output repeated sixteen times per parent; distinct-output workload has higher fanout.
Neither metadata decoder verifies Ed25519 signatures; both retain canonical wire and field checks.
Medians are descriptive repetitions, not statistical significance or confidence intervals.
